# Open Workflow Specification

Files copied unchanged from [open-workflow-specification/specification](https://github.com/open-workflow-specification/specification) at commit `3aa1687ce4ab38f1d2dbede500b3077c4f801b66` (2026-10, DSL 1.0.4), under the Apache License 2.0 in `LICENSE`.

- `schema/workflow.yaml`: the workflow JSON Schema.
- `ctk/features/`: the conformance test kit.

To update, copy the same paths from a newer commit, update the commit here, and run `mise run test`.
